decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric has its own website page, a visible commitment close to the core offer, and was launched only in 2023, so any weak results can still be attributed to the early market phase.
The semi-transparent bouclé-effect fabric fits the established decorative range and has had little time to prove itself, though its lighter website presence means less public commitment to justify.
The flame-retardant jacquard serves contract and hospitality customers, has its own website page and reflects development investment, so management will strongly persist with it.

The double-face wool-blend fabric builds on the firm's offer and uses renewable fiber, in line with the announced sustainability direction, which justifies continued commitment despite only modest visibility.
The wool bouclé leno fabric required development effort and fits the move toward renewable materials, so management will attribute any slow uptake to temporary causes and keep it.
